title: User Create Request
description: Create a new RMS user account. 'username' (a valid e-mail address) and 'password' are required. All other fields are optional.

username.description: Login e-mail of the new user. Must not already exist.

canLogin.description: Whether the user is allowed to log in. Defaults to true.

lang.description: Preferred locale in ll_CC format, e.g. "en_US".

givenName.description: Given (first) name stored as user meta.

familyName.description: Family (last) name stored as user meta.

grant.description: Rights to grant to the new user, e.g. ["member of administrators"].
